workPhilosophy.title: I Choose Projects That Excite Me
workPhilosophy.description: I'm selective about my work. I take on projects where I can bring serious value while genuinely enjoying the process. My focus is on setting up systems and automating processes — building engines, not driving them long-term.

workPhilosophy.title: Straight-Up Transparency
workPhilosophy.description: If a project isn't my thing, I'll tell you upfront and connect you with someone in my network who's the perfect fit. I'm the matchmaker of business solutions — creating win-win moments.

workPhilosophy.title: Quality Over Quantity

faq.question: What types of businesses do you work with?
faq.answer: I work primarily with SMBs and startups across the US, Canada, EU, UK, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, and France. My sweet spot is founders and decision-makers who can move fast without corporate red tape.

faq.question: How do you typically engage with clients?
faq.answer: Most projects start with a discovery call to understand your needs. From there, I provide a proposal with clear scope, timeline, and pricing. I work on a project basis, not hourly, so you know exactly what you're getting.

faq.question: What's your typical project timeline?
faq.answer: Most CRM implementations take 2-4 weeks. Automation projects vary from 1-6 weeks depending on complexity. No-code app development typically takes 4-8 weeks for a full MVP.

faq.question: Do you offer ongoing support?
faq.answer: I focus on building systems, not managing them long-term. However, I do offer training and documentation to ensure your team can maintain what I build. For ongoing needs, I can recommend partners from my network.

faq.question: What makes you different from other consultants?
faq.answer: I combine technical expertise (former software engineer at Cisco) with business acumen (MBA + consulting at ZS Associates). I'm certified across multiple platforms and have maintained 100% 5-star reviews across 200+ clients since 2016.
